basic_info.description: Don't miss this Pacific Heights rare offering! Top Floor corner home with Sweeping Views of the City lights and Bay beyond. The home is flooded with natural light, rich wood & luxe stone interior finishes along with numerous custom built-ins. There is an open floor plan with two bedrooms, one a spacious primary bedroom en suite with a walk-in closet. The coveted split-bedroom floor plan, including two full baths, is ideal for guests, roommates or working from home. It is a true urban oasis! The sunny palm courtyard is just minutes away from your front door, where relaxing in a heated pool and spa awaits you! This sought after building is well-managed, centrally located, and designed for convenience with two elegant lobbies, Security 24/7, on-site property management, Gym, deeded Parking + extra Storage. Experience the thriving neighborhoods of upper Polk, Fillmore and Union Street which offer boutique shops, tons of fine dining, outdoor cafes galore, all you want in vibrant city living within steps of your front door! 98 Walk/Transit Score 98-100.
